# GEO Criteria

> The public reference for the criteria behind LightSpot's audits: the checks that decide whether a page is likely to be cited by an AI answer engine.

## Docs

- [Criteria](https://github.com/nmarijane/geo-criteria/blob/main/criteria.md): the full list of SEO and GEO criteria, with severity, pass condition, and impact or rationale.
- [Scoring](https://github.com/nmarijane/geo-criteria/blob/main/scoring.md): points, weighting, grade bands, and skip rules.
- [Glossary](https://github.com/nmarijane/geo-criteria/blob/main/glossary.md): definitions for the vocabulary used across this repository.
- [README](https://github.com/nmarijane/geo-criteria/blob/main/README.md): what this repository is and how to use it.
- [License](https://github.com/nmarijane/geo-criteria/blob/main/LICENSE): terms of reuse.

## Learn more

- [LightSpot](https://lightspot.ai): run the audit these criteria come from.
